newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Moderate gain seen on Fairform debut.
newsitem.headline: Moderate gain seen on Fairform debut.

text.p: Shares of household and bathroom products maker Fairform Holdings Ltd are expected to post moderate gains when they begin trading on Wednesday, analysts said on Monday.
Analysts said a warm subscription response in Fairform's initial public offering (IPO) of shares in Hong Kong had indicated investors' interest in the stock.

Fairform issued 57 million new shares at HK$1.08 each in an initial public offering in Hong Kong, of which the 51.3 million shares offered to the public were 56.8 times subscribed. Another 5.7 million shares reserved for employees were fully allotted.
"A price jump is expected in view of the warm subscription response, but the company's fundamentals are not that exciting," said Ben Kwong, research director at Dharmala Securities.

Fairform is involved in the design, development, manufacture and sale of electric personal care and healthcare products, and bathroom accessories. The company's products are mainly for export to Europe and the United States.
